summary.text: Steve Jarvis is a Republican state senator from North Carolina who represents District 30, covering Davidson and Davie counties, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, against Democrat Pamela D. McAfee.
A business owner, he served in the North Carolina House of Representatives from 2019 to 2021.

paragraphs.text: Jarvis was born in Anderson, Indiana, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as business owner.
He represented District 80 in the North Carolina House from 2019 to 2021 and has served in the Senate since 2021.
The General Assembly's website shows Jarvis chairing the Regulatory Reform Committee and serving as vice chair of the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Information Technology.
He also serves on the Agriculture, Energy, and Environment; Commerce and Insurance; State and Local Government; and Transportation committees, among others.
Jarvis advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
